description.text: The discipline of Food Science and Engineering was established in 1980. In accordance with the readjustment of disciplines, the department of Food Science and Engineering was founded in 1993, and renamed the College of Food Science and Engineering in 2005. At present there are 3 undergraduate programs in food science and engineering, biological engineering and food quality and safety. The college is accredited to offer 2 master degree programs in Agricultural Products Processing & Storage Engineering and Food Science. We also offer one characteristic specialty of Food Science and Engineering in Shandong province, one key laboratory of Modern Agriculture Quality and Safety Engineering in Qingdao and 3 college institues. The college has a staff of 66 members, including 9 professors and 14 associate professors. Most of the teaching staff are either doctor or master degree holders. It shows that their academic excellence and are beloved by the students. The college has undertaken various research projects, and has obtained outstanding achievements in theoretic and applied research as well as production and extension, including national programs, provincial important bid or key programs and so on. Besides, the amount of papers published in domestic and foreign scientific journals mount to over 400, in which 19 papers were published in SCI & EI journals. At present the college has established excellent co-operative relations with near 20 famous institutes of higher learning and scientific research institutes at home and abroad, including Department of Agriculture of Canada, Kagoshima University of Japan, Kaya University of South Korea, and Longda Group of China, etc. All these activities have undoubtedly stimulated the vigorous development of internationalized education and research in the college.

duration.text: The Food Science and Engineering at Qingdao agriculture university is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2083 USD/per year ￥ 15000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3or above 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Graduation certificate of high school Gradution certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not,it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.

requirements.text: Applicant is under the age of 25, and is in good health, high-school graduate with good marks. The HSK score should reach level 3 or above
